items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I would think that maybe Joe Helback, the owner of the Club, decided that it would be better for me to sing with the orchestra.

ctx.x: Did he manage the Kirby Band also, in any way?

No, not really, Kirby did his own managing. I would think that maybe Joe Helback, the owner of the Club, decided that it would be better for me to sing with the orchestra. And things just happened, you know, one right after the other. As I said before, I had exposure on the broadcasting system. They were swinging at its peak then. I had appeared on the program called the Saturday Night Swing Club. And all this time I was getting all this exposure. And then, of course, when I did 'Loch Lomond' on the air and it…
